items.stem: A system calls a language model and also runs tools. What decides whether it is a workflow or an agent?

options.text: Whether the system calls any tools at all
Whether code or the model picks each next step

items.stem: The assistant calls the model three times in a row, always in the same fixed order, to answer one student question. Is this an agent?

options.text: Yes, because the model is called three times

items.stem: Checking if a machine is free always follows the same three steps in the same order. Why fit a fixed workflow here?

options.text: There is nothing here for a model to decide

A workflow needs no model budget at all
A fixed workflow only works for simple tasks

items.stem: A student's question about a manual may need an unknown number of searches, depending on what turns up. Why fit an agent here?

options.text: Agents are cheaper to run per request
Fixed workflows cannot call a search tool
Agents are always more accurate than workflows
The path can't be fixed ahead of time
